raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Starting 2026-01-15, customers migrated from the new CRM carry numeric region codes ('01' to '04') in raw_customers.region, which silver_customers passes through unmapped. raw_region_map gives the authoritative code-to-name mapping (01 WEST, 02 EAST, 03 NORTH, 04 SOUTH), so a left join to it, with the existing upper(region) as fallback, restores the four region names without changing rows or columns.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.9, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_customers": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_customers AS SELECT c.customer_id, COALESCE(m.region_name, upper(c.region)) AS region FROM raw_customers c LEFT JOIN raw_region_map m ON m.region_code = c.region;"}}
